item.content:encoded:
Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity today, and women are increasingly recognized as powerful drivers of innovative, inclusive, and sustainable climate solutions. To strengthen women’s capacity to lead meaningful environmental change, the United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR), in partnership with C40 Cities and with the exclusive support of the Fondation L’Oréal, has launched the Developing Skills for Women Leadership in Climate Action online course. This self-paced international e-learning programme is designed to inspire, educate, and empower women and girls to become effective climate leaders capable of developing and implementing inclusive climate initiatives within their communities and beyond.

Whether you are just beginning your climate leadership journey or already working on environmental projects, this comprehensive online course provides the scientific knowledge, leadership skills, and practical tools needed to transform climate ideas into impactful actions.

About the Developing Skills for Women Leadership in Climate Action Course

The Developing Skills for Women Leadership in Climate Action course is an international online learning programme that equips women and girls with the knowledge and confidence needed to tackle climate challenges through inclusive leadership.

The programme combines climate science with practical leadership development, enabling learners to understand climate issues while learning how to design, lead, and advocate for equitable climate solutions.

Developed through a collaboration between globally respected organizations, the course brings together expertise from:

  • United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR)
  • C40 Cities
  • Fondation L’Oréal
  • Columbia Climate School
  • CARE France

The programme recognizes that although women are among those most affected by climate change, they remain significantly underrepresented in climate decision-making processes. By strengthening leadership capacity, the course seeks to bridge this gap and encourage greater participation of women in climate governance and action.

Why This Course Matters

Climate change affects every country, yet its impacts are not distributed equally.

Women and girls often experience disproportionate effects due to existing social and economic inequalities. At the same time, women play an essential role in developing resilient communities, promoting sustainable practices, and advancing climate justice.

This course addresses these realities by helping participants:

  • Understand climate science.
  • Learn the principles of inclusive climate action.
  • Build confidence as climate leaders.
  • Develop practical climate projects.
  • Influence decision-makers and communities.
  • Promote equitable climate solutions.
  • Create resilient and sustainable communities.

The course emphasizes that climate action must be both environmentally effective and socially inclusive.

What You Will Learn

By completing this programme, participants will gain a broad understanding of climate change alongside practical leadership skills.

Upon completion, learners will be able to:

1. Understand Climate Change

Participants will learn:

  • What climate change is
  • The causes of global warming
  • The impacts of climate change worldwide
  • Scientific foundations of climate science
  • Climate mitigation and adaptation strategies

2. Understand Inclusive Climate Action

Learners will explore:

  • Climate justice
  • Equity in climate policies
  • Inclusive environmental decision-making
  • Community participation
  • Sustainable development approaches

3. Explore Women’s Role in Climate Action

Participants will examine:

  • Why women are central to climate solutions
  • Gender inequalities within climate governance
  • Women’s contributions to environmental sustainability
  • Leadership opportunities for women in climate action

4. Plan Effective Climate Projects

The course introduces practical methods for:

  • Identifying community climate challenges
  • Designing impactful projects
  • Developing implementation strategies
  • Managing climate initiatives
  • Evaluating project outcomes

5. Strengthen Leadership Skills

Participants will develop skills in:

  • Leadership
  • Communication
  • Advocacy
  • Collaboration
  • Decision-making
  • Strategic planning
  • Team building

6. Influence Others and Build Support

Learners will understand how to:

  • Advocate for climate action
  • Engage stakeholders
  • Mobilize communities
  • Communicate climate solutions effectively
  • Inspire collective action

7. Build Personal Resilience

Climate leadership often involves overcoming challenges.

Participants will also learn techniques for:

  • Maintaining motivation
  • Building resilience
  • Managing obstacles
  • Sustaining long-term climate engagement

Course Structure

The course contains five comprehensive sections that guide learners from climate science fundamentals to practical project development.

Module 1: Introduction to Climate Change and Inclusive Climate Action

This introductory module covers:

  • Climate science fundamentals
  • Causes of climate change
  • Environmental impacts
  • Social implications
  • Principles of inclusive climate action

Module 2: Women at the Heart of Climate Action

This module focuses on:

  • Women’s leadership
  • Gender equality
  • Climate justice
  • Women’s role in sustainable development
  • Real-world examples of women-led climate initiatives

Module 3: Taking the Lead on Inclusive Climate Action

Participants learn practical leadership approaches including:

  • Project planning
  • Community engagement
  • Inclusive leadership techniques
  • Climate project development

Module 4: Influencing Change While Staying Resilient

Topics include:

  • Communication strategies
  • Advocacy
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Leadership resilience
  • Building long-term impact

Module 5: Course Wrap-Up

The final section provides:

  • Practical guidance
  • Climate project development tools
  • Action planning resources
  • Recommendations for future climate leadership

Course Duration

The programme requires approximately:

  • 9 hours of learning
  • 3 practical exercises
  • Entirely self-paced learning

Participants can complete the course according to their own schedule without fixed class times.

Languages Available

To ensure global accessibility, the course is offered in:

  • English
  • French
  • Spanish

This multilingual approach enables participants from different regions of the world to benefit from the training.

Certification

Participants who successfully complete the course can obtain an official UNITAR Digital Certificate.

To qualify:

  • Score at least 70% on all quizzes.
  • Learners have three attempts per quiz.
  • After passing all quizzes, participants may purchase the official digital certificate for USD 30.

The digital certificate allows graduates to:

  • Verify their achievement online.
  • Share their accomplishment with employers.
  • Strengthen professional profiles.
  • Demonstrate climate leadership skills.

Interested applicants should click HERE

Learn more about the course HERE

Benefit of Taking This Course

Participants will gain numerous professional and personal benefits, including:

  • International training from a United Nations institution.
  • Self-paced online learning.
  • Flexible study schedule.
  • Comprehensive climate science education.
  • Leadership development.
  • Practical project planning skills.
  • Knowledge of inclusive climate action.
  • Global perspectives from leading climate experts.
  • Opportunity to earn a recognized UN digital certificate.
  • Enhanced career prospects in sustainability and climate-related fields.
  • Improved advocacy and communication skills.
  • Access to practical tools for launching climate initiatives.

Organizations Behind the Programme

UNITAR

The United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) develops innovative learning solutions that strengthen global decision-making and sustainable development.

UNITAR supports governments, organizations, and individuals worldwide, with particular attention to developing countries, Least Developed Countries (LDCs), Small Island Developing States (SIDS), and vulnerable communities.

C40 Cities

C40 Cities is a global network of nearly 100 major cities committed to tackling climate change.

The organization works with city leaders, businesses, civil society, youth movements, and experts to:

  • Reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
  • Promote climate resilience.
  • Advance equitable climate policies.
  • Support sustainable urban development.

Fondation L’Oréal

The Fondation L’Oréal supports women through initiatives focused on:

  • Scientific research
  • Climate action
  • Women’s empowerment
  • Inclusive development

Its Women and Climate programme specifically supports women leading innovative climate projects and promotes gender-sensitive climate solutions worldwide.

Why You Should Enroll

If you want to become part of the global movement addressing climate change, this course provides an excellent foundation.

Whether you are:

  • A student,
  • An environmental advocate,
  • A young professional,
  • A community organizer,
  • A policymaker,
  • An entrepreneur,
  • Or simply passionate about protecting the planet,

this programme equips you with the knowledge, leadership skills, and confidence needed to create meaningful environmental impact.

Because the course is self-paced, learners can complete it alongside their studies or professional commitments, making it accessible regardless of their schedule.

Conclusion

The Developing Skills for Women Leadership in Climate Action course is more than an online training programme—it is an opportunity to empower women and girls to become leaders in one of the world’s most pressing challenges. By combining climate science, leadership development, and practical project planning, the programme prepares participants to create inclusive and equitable climate solutions within their communities and beyond. Delivered by UNITAR in partnership with C40 Cities and supported by Fondation L’Oréal, the course reflects international expertise and a commitment to advancing women’s leadership in climate action. With flexible self-paced learning, multilingual content, and the opportunity to earn a recognized UN digital certificate, this programme is an outstanding opportunity for aspiring climate leaders across the globe to build the skills necessary to drive meaningful and lasting environmental change.
